title: Tej I Love You
desc: Tej, a young man, gets banished from his family for breaking his sister's marriage. He moves to London where he falls in love with a beautiful girl, Nandini.

title: Nani's Dasara
desc: In a gritty coal mining town, political tensions and power struggles complicate a love triangle between three longtime friends, testing their bonds.

title: Oru Nodi
desc: When a man goes missing under perplexing circumstances, a police inspector embarks on a quest to investigate the case, exposing a concealed network of political corruption.

title: Nandhi Varman
desc: Paranormal activities begin to happen when a crew starts excavating a temple that is believed to be concealed beneath the earth.

title: Anbarivu
desc: Twins, Anbu and Arivu, are separated at birth. Later, when their paths cross, the siblings are forced to switch families, as they strive to reunite their loved ones.

title: Engal Ayya
desc: A righteous professor rescues a student from the evil clutches of thugs and learns of her plight. After deciding to protect her from harm, he ends up falling in love with her.
